snippet.title: Welcome to Doll Town - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to Doll Town will be playable as a demo on October 2025 during the STEAM NEXT FEST and is scheduled to be released on February 13th 2026.

In "Welcome to Doll Town," explore a cursed village where lifelike dolls roam. Uncover dark secrets, solve eerie puzzles, and survive the haunted dollhouses to escape a twisted nightmare.

Wishlist "Welcome to Doll Town" now on Steam: https://wishlist.welcometodolltown.com

#horrorgaming
